stories.title: Oracle to Patch 11 Java Flaws Today as Critical OpenJDK RCE (CVE-2026-114938) Report Emerges
stories.summary: Oracle is preparing to release security patches for 11 vulnerabilities in Java SE on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, all of which may be exploited remotely without authentication, as separate reports warn of a potentially critical remote code execution (RCE) flaw affecting OpenJDK. The 11 vulnerabilities carry a maximum CVSS 3.1 severity score of 8.1, according to Oracle's advance security notice.

stories.title: Critical Java4Shell flaw allows RCE attacks on major Java applications
stories.summary: A critical vulnerability dubbed Java4Shell in OpenJDK, the open-source implementation of Java, can allow unauthenticated attackers to remotely execute code on popular enterprise applications, including Jenkins, Atlassian Jira, Confluence, and Keycloak.

stories.title: CISA Urges Immediate Patching of Java4Shell Flaw That Could Allow Remote Code Execution
stories.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has urged organizations to immediately patch a newly disclosed critical security flaw impacting Oracle Java. stories.title: Apache warns of Roller RCE vulnerability exploited in attacks
stories.summary: Apache has released security updates to address a critical Roller flaw that threat actors are exploiting to gain code execution on vulnerable servers.

stories.title: Hackers Found a Way Around GitHub SHA Pinning. This Webinar Explains How to Close the Gap
stories.summary: Pinning GitHub Actions to an exact version of their code, known as SHA pinning, has become the go-to defense against software supply chain attacks.
